run_gen_gtest_pred_impl: run the script with a max arity integer to generate gtest predicate assertion header and unit test files
generate_header: generate the gtest_pred_impl.h header file with predicate assertion macros up to a given arity
generate_unittest: generate the gtest_pred_impl_unittest.cc unit test file with tests for predicate assertions up to a given arity
implementation_for_arity: generate the C++ implementation template for n-ary predicate assertion macros including helper functions and macros
tests_for_arity: generate the C++ unit test code for n-ary predicate assertions covering all combinations of format, assert, functor, and user types
